_note: All URLs are base_url + path. To move domains: change base_url (and PUBLIC_URL on the server), run `deno run -A deploy/gen_listings.ts <new base_url>`, then resubmit each directory below. null = not decided / not known yet.

service.name: Base Reads
service.summary: Pay-per-call read API for Base over x402 v2. Deterministic data, no advice.

ref.format: A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - ; max 64; first occurrence wins; recorded with paid calls only; never changes price or challenge

bazaar.listing_kind: automatic: indexed from settled payments through the CDP facilitator; listing is keyed by the resource URL (base_url + path)
bazaar.resubmit_on_domain_change: one settled paid call per route at the new base_url

402index.resubmit_on_domain_change: register the new base_url and re-verify ownership

verify.source: INDEX_VERIFY_TOKEN env, else built-in default; a new domain may get a new token

x402scan.listing_kind: manual registration of the origin; reads the 402 challenge and /openapi.json

routes.description: Live Base mainnet USDC and ETH balance for one address, read with eth_call at the latest block; returns decimal and raw values plus the block number. Use it to check a wallet can cover a payment or that funds arrived before acting. Simpler than running an RPC client and decoding ERC-20 calls yourself, and the block number makes each reading reproducible. Query: ?address=0x...

Base mainnet transaction status: success, failed or pending, with block, confirmations, gas used, effective gas price, from/to and log count. Use it after sending or receiving a payment to confirm it landed and how deep it is. One normalized JSON answer instead of combining receipt and block calls and computing confirmations yourself. Query: ?hash=0x...

Resolve a Basename (name.base.eth) to its Base address, or an address to its primary Basename, checked both ways so a reverse name is only returned when it resolves back. Use it to turn a human name into a payout address or to label an address. Avoids hand-written ENS-style namehash and resolver calls. Query: ?name=jesse.base.eth or ?address=0x...

One call for an address on Base: USDC balance, ETH balance, verified primary Basename, transaction count (nonce) and whether it is a contract. Use it to profile a counterparty or payout wallet before interacting. Replaces four or five separate reads with a single priced request. Query: ?address=0x...

Pre-pay Check: Ed25519-signed, deterministic facts about another x402 endpoint before you pay it: challenge validity, reachability and latency, host listing count, payout wallet reuse across hosts, last-called and payer trend from daily Bazaar snapshots. Use it when choosing between paid endpoints. Signed facts you can verify against the published key, not ratings; facts only, no advice. Query: ?url=https://...

Base mainnet head: latest block number, block age in seconds, base fee and gas price in gwei. Use it to check the chain is advancing and to estimate fees before sending a transaction. One small JSON read instead of several raw RPC calls and unit conversions.
